Independent concept, quality, coverage, docs, Claude CLI and Agy/Codex-host audits found the final design non-duplicative, mechanically enforceable, migration-safe, and ready to authorize for separate implementation Stories. usage: Use this audited document to authorize and create separate Wave 1, 1A, 2, 2A, 3, 3A, and 4 implementation Stories. Preserve its canonical ownership and phase boundaries; do not create a writable acceptance matrix or claim runtime gates were delivered by B-4444.
